# porkbun_dnssec_records (Data Source)

Retrieves all DNSSEC records associated with the domain at the registry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "porkbun_dnssec_records" "example" {
  domain = "jiancodes.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain name.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes Set) All DNSSEC records. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `alg` (String)
- `digest` (String)
- `digest_type` (String)
- `key_tag` (String)
- `pub_key` (String)
